targeting_note: Each lambda was applied with -target=module.<name>.aws_lambda_function.this. Four roots plan clean 0/1/0 untargeted; export plans 6 ADDS (the commentary-composition reader, cell AR-t-13 / IB-pr-397) and ycharts 1 ADD (aws_iam_role_policy.generate_custody_factory). Both predate this order and belong to other cells, and the signed halves admit no IAM, route, schedule or env change, so an untargeted apply would have EXCEEDED the sign-off. Targeting NARROWS to exactly the signed radius; all six plans then read 0 add / 1 change / 0 destroy.
